Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human GnRH receptor (CHEMBL1855). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, compound_records on record_id, docs on doc_id, and compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter target chembl_id to CHEMBL1855 and standard_type to IC50. Require canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows (no DISTINCT). Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
